name: verified-codegen
description: Turn AI-generated code into verified-before-merge code. A language-neutral pipeline of 10 role-separated subagents (planner, architect, devops, coder, scenarist, destroyer, fixer, tester, reviewer, author) with a Destroyer that intentionally hunts failure cases, a scenario+test quality gate, a bounded feedback loop, and git-safety hooks. Coder and Scenarist run in parallel.
